name: How do I choose a qualified contractor for storm damage repair in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a qualified contractor for storm damage repair in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for storm damage repair in the Bay Area, look for one with local experience and a strong reputation for restoration work. Verify they are licensed and insured in California. Ask for references and check their past projects. Ensure they are familiar with local building codes and can assist with insurance claims. A contractor with transparent communication and a detailed estimate is essential for a smooth restoration process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a Bay Area contractor with local experience, licensing, insurance, strong references, and expertise in navigating insurance claims.
